effect_size.excerpt: Among 13 other nutrients examined, the odds ratios in the top third of intake were below 0.8 for: potassium, 0.74 (0.51-1.09; P for trend = 0.054); zinc, 0.73 (0.49-1.08; P for trend = 0.126); iodine, 0.75 (0.51-1.11; P for trend = 0.077); vitamin B6 food only, 0.77 (0.53-1.12; P for trend = 0.077); and vitamin B6 including supplements, 0.70 (0.48-1.03; P for trend = 0.029). studies.Title: A prospective study of iodine status, thyroid function, and prostate cancer risk: follow-up of the First National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.
studies.Reference: A prospective study of iodine status, thyroid function, and prostate cancer risk: follow-up of the First National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.
studies.Population: Men in the NHANES I Epidemiologic Follow-up Study
studies.comparison_type: High versus low urinary iodine tertile

extraction_supporting_text.effect_size: Relative to the group with low urinary iodine, the age-adjusted hazard ratio was higher (although marginally insignificant) in the moderate group, hazard ratio 1.33 (95% confidence interval 1.00-1.78), and significantly lower in the high group, 0.71 (0.51-0.99). Thyroid disease was associated with an increased prostate cancer risk, 2.34 (1.24-4.43).
extraction_supporting_text.confidence_interval: Relative to the group with low urinary iodine, the age-adjusted hazard ratio was higher (although marginally insignificant) in the moderate group, hazard ratio 1.33 (95% confidence interval 1.00-1.78), and significantly lower in the high group, 0.71 (0.51-0.99).
extraction_supporting_text.comparison: Relative to the group with low urinary iodine, the age-adjusted hazard ratio was higher (although marginally insignificant) in the moderate group
extraction_supporting_text.design: We investigated iodine status and prostate cancer risk prospectively using data from the NHANES I Epidemiologic Follow-up Study.
extraction_supporting_text.timing: A prospective study of iodine status, thyroid function, and prostate cancer risk
extraction_supporting_text.continent: data from the NHANES I Epidemiologic Follow-up Study
extraction_supporting_text.exposure_measurement: Participants were stratified into tertiles according to the urinary iodine/creatinine ratio, as a marker of iodine exposure.
